mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate over the past 3 months (measured by FEDFUNDS change) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce discount rates for equity valuations and stimulate economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declined by at least 0.1% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as rising joblessness signals economic contraction and reduced corporate earnings potential.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increased by >0.2pp in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) combined with a stable or declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS change < 0.05%) signals stagflation risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS change < 0.05%.

mechanism_narrative: During economic expansion regimes, housing starts (HOUST) above 1000 thousand units predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as strong housing activity supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of expansion periods when HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as stronger manufacturing output signals expanding economic activity and corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly nonfarm payrolls increase exceeding 200 thousand units predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as robust job creation supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth in the short term.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increased by >200 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) combined with a declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS change < -0.1% over 1 month) indicates a dovish monetary policy stance, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS change < -0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: In recession regimes (quarterly GDP growth < 0%), a quarterly GDP growth rate exceeding 0.5% predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as accelerating economic activity signals a recovery in corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of recession periods when GDPC1 growth > 0.5%.
